add_library(r33_stereo_inputs STATIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/stereo/backend/src/stereo_inputs.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/backend/src/full_camera.cpp")
target_include_directories(r33_stereo_inputs PUBLIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/stereo/backend/include")
target_link_libraries(r33_stereo_inputs PUBLIC app_support runtime_status)
if(R20_WITH_BPU AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_compile_definitions(r33_stereo_inputs PRIVATE R33_WITH_MO=1)
  target_include_directories(r33_stereo_inputs SYSTEM PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/third_party/mo_sdk/include")
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(r33_stereo_inputs PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
else()
  target_compile_options(r33_stereo_inputs PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(r33_stereo_input_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/stereo/tests/stereo_input_tests.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(r33_stereo_input_tests PRIVATE r33_stereo_inputs)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(r33_stereo_input_tests PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME r33_Q8_identity_stride_ownership_NOT_camera_hardware COMMAND r33_stereo_input_tests)
endif()
